column1: # The Constitutional Council's decisions on a text, as the Council published
# them, shown on the text's page and next to each article they name. The
# wording of the text stays as published: a decision is noted, never applied
# to it. One row for the decision on the text as a whole (article empty),
# then one for each article it annulled or annulled in part.
# Columns: law id, article (as legislation_article.number), effect
# when the Council found the text never validly came into force, is for the
# text as a whole only), decision (the Council's
# number, as 5/2025), decided on, source address (the Council's decision, or
# the Gazette that printed it), note in English, note in Arabic (quote the
# decision's own operative words where they fit). A person checks each row
# against its source before it is added.

column7: The Council rejected the request to annul the whole law, annulled words in articles 2 and 3, and attached binding interpretive reservations to articles 1, 2 and 3; the reservations are in the decision. (Unofficial translation; the Arabic is official.)
column8: «رد المراجعة بالنسبة الى طلب إبطال القانون المطعون فيه رقم ٢٠٢٦/٧٠ كلياً، وإبطاله جزئياً وقبول المراجعة بالنسبة لتحصينه بتحفظات تفسيرية ملزمة».

column7: The Council annulled the words "and committed before this law was issued" in the second paragraph of item 5, and "if committed before this law was issued" in its third paragraph, so that 1 March 2026 is the one cut-off date for every offence the amnesty covers, drug offences and drug cultivation included. (Unofficial translation; the Arabic is official.)
column8: «ابطال عبارة "والمرتكبة قبل صدور هذا القانون" من الفقرة الثانية من البند الخامس من المادة الثانية وعبارة "في حال كانت مرتكبة قبل صدور هذا القانون" من الفقرة الثالثة من البند إياه، بحيث يعتمد تاريخ 2026/3/1 حداً زمنياً موحداً لجميع الجرائم المشمولة بالعفو بما فيها جرائم المخدرات وزراعتها».

column7: The Council struck the words "before 1/3/2026" from the last paragraph of this article. (Unofficial translation; the Arabic is official.)
column8: «شطب عبارة "قبل 2026/3/1" من الفقرة الأخيرة من المادة الثالثة».

column7: The Council accepted both challenges and declared this law not in force. It found that the procedure for issuing the law was not followed, so the President's one-month period to issue it had not run out and the law had not come into force by operation of law when it was published, contrary to Article 57 of the Constitution; it therefore did not rule on the law's content. Printed in the Official Gazette, issue 23 of 22 May 2025, pages 1329 to 1337. (Unofficial translation; the Arabic is official.)
column8: «قبول المراجعتين أساساً وإعلان عدم نفاذ القانون المطعون فيه رقم 1 الصادر بتاريخ 2025/4/3 المتعلّق بالإيجارات للأماكن غير السكنية حكماً». الجريدة الرسمية، العدد 23 تاريخ 2025/5/22، الصفحات 1329 إلى 1337.
